note: Classification of every catalog ecosystem (the byEcosystem index of the rule catalog). kind=language|iac carries the literal root-marker files that detect the ecosystem in a project; kind=exclude carries a documented reason. Languages and frameworks without a fixed root marker use their closest config file. Rule-source tools (codeql/ql/semgrep-unified), cross-language rule buckets (generic/regex/secrets/text/common), cloud-provider rule buckets and ingestion artifacts are excluded, because they are not detectable project ecosystems.

argo_workflows.reason: 2 rules; Argo Workflows CRDs are Kubernetes manifests — covered by checkov under the kubernetes profile.

serverless.reason: = serverlessfw (Serverless Framework; kics naming); covered by the serverlessfw profile.

azure_pipelines.reason: CI pipeline config rule bucket (kics); no standalone bundled linter — the CI provider validates its own config.

bitbucket_pipelines.reason: CI pipeline config rule bucket (kics); no standalone bundled linter.

bitbucket.reason: VCS platform config rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

circleci_pipelines.reason: CI pipeline config rule bucket (kics); no standalone bundled linter.

example_runner.reason: ingestion example artifact, not a project ecosystem.

github.reason: VCS platform config rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

gitlab_ci.reason: CI pipeline config rule bucket (kics); no standalone bundled linter.

gitlab.reason: VCS platform config rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

actions.reason: = github_actions (rule bucket); covered by the github_actions profile.

codeql.reason: CodeQL is a cross-language analysis engine and rule SOURCE, not a target ecosystem; its findings apply to the profiled languages.

ql.reason: QL is CodeQL's query language (rule source), not a project ecosystem.

test.reason: ingestion test artifact, not a project ecosystem.

unified.reason: semgrep cross-language 'unified' rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

json.reason: JSON is a data format within other ecosystems, not a standalone project type; formatting is the host project's (prettier).

azureresourcemanager.reason: = arm (Azure Resource Manager; kics naming); covered by the arm profile.

buildah.reason: 1 rule; container build — covered by dockerfile/hadolint.

cicd.reason: generic CI/CD rule bucket (kics); the concrete CI systems are separate buckets.

common.reason: shared/common rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

crossplane.reason: Crossplane CRDs; niche, no standalone root marker — checkov covers them under kubernetes.

googledeploymentmanager.reason: GCP Deployment Manager config; niche, no standalone root marker; requires-live-verification.

knative.reason: 1 rule; Knative CRDs — covered by checkov under kubernetes.

modelica.reason: Modelica — niche modeling language; no bundled linter; requires-live-verification.

apex.reason: Salesforce Apex — PMD Apex ruleset; niche, no bundled invocation; requires-live-verification.

ecmascript.reason: = javascript (sonar's ECMAScript rule bucket); covered by the javascript profile.

xsl.reason: XSL (sonar); XML transform data within other ecosystems, no standalone linter.

velocity.reason: Apache Velocity templates (sonar); niche, no bundled linter.

html.reason: HTML (sonar); markup within web projects; no bundled standalone linter.

plsql.reason: PL/SQL (sonar); no standalone root marker/bundled dialect linter; generic SQL is covered by sqlfluff.

jsp.reason: JSP (sonar); Java web templates — covered under the java profile.

pom.reason: Maven POM (sonar); build metadata within java — covered under the java profile.

xml.reason: XML (sonar); data format within other ecosystems, not a standalone project type.

visualforce.reason: Visualforce (Salesforce); niche, no bundled linter; requires-live-verification.

regex.reason: regex-pattern rule bucket (semgrep/generic), not a project ecosystem.

generic.reason: generic/cross-language rule bucket (semgrep/kics), not a project ecosystem.

hcl.reason: = terraform/HCL (kics/trivy HCL bucket); covered by the terraform profile.

ocaml.reason: OCaml (sonar); no bundled linter (dune/merlin) in the catalog; requires-live-verification.

c.reason: C shares clang tooling with C++ — covered by the cpp profile (clang-tidy/clang-format run across the tree).

bash.reason: = shell (shellcheck); covered by the shell profile.

vbnet.reason: VB.NET (sonar); no distinct project marker vs C#; covered by the .NET toolchain under the csharp profile.

secrets.reason: secret-detection rule bucket (cross-cutting); handled by a secret scanner (gitleaks/trufflehog), not a language profile.

text.reason: generic text rule bucket, not a project ecosystem.

aws.reason: cloud-provider rule bucket (trivy/checkov/kics) — the provider is a target of terraform/cloudformation, not a detectable project ecosystem; covered by the IaC profiles' scanners.
